# Requirements Intel

**Generated by:** gsd-doc-synthesizer (MERGE mode)
**Ingest date:** 2026-06-30
**Source classifications:** .planning/intel/classifications/ (33 docs: 25 PRD + 8 DOC)

This file extracts per-PRD requirement groups from the 25 newly-ingested PRDs under
`documentazione/15-ambiti-estensione/`. Each group is keyed with a domain prefix so the
roadmapper can map **one phase per vertical domain** (the user has decided to PROMOTE the
verticals from the v2 umbrella items AMBIT-01/AMBIT-02 to granular v1 phases — see
INGEST-CONFLICTS.md [WARNING] "Roadmap restructure"). The 8 DOC-type docs (v1.0 functional
specs + roadmap) yield no new requirements; their gap-check is preserved at the bottom.

Grouping:
- APPLICATION verticals — Consumer (TUR, EVT, RIST, ITIN, EDU, CULT, SPORT, COMM, RE, SAN)
- APPLICATION verticals — Enterprise (ENT-KB, ARCH, PROC, PERS, CRM, MAIL, TICK, ONB, COMP)
- CROSS-CUTTING domains (KGCORE, GRAG, VIZX, MOD, INGX, SEC) — these RE-ENFORCE existing
  ROADMAP phases 1-7 and the existing GRAPH/RAG/VIZ/INGEST/PRIV/SCHEMA requirement families;
  treat as enrichment, not new phases (see INGEST-CONFLICTS.md [INFO] auto-resolved overlaps).

Node-type / edge-type / connector / weight detail per domain lives in `constraints.md`;
personas and narrative rationale live in `context.md`.

## CROSS-CUTTING DOMAINS (enrich existing ROADMAP phases 1-7)

These six PRDs are NOT new verticals. They describe the universal engine and its
cross-cutting capabilities and overlap existing ROADMAP phases 1-7 and the existing
GRAPH/SCHEMA/SEARCH/RAG/VIZ/INGEST/PRIV requirement families. The roadmapper should fold
them into the existing core phases rather than create new phases — see INGEST-CONFLICTS.md
[INFO] auto-resolved overlaps. Requirements below are recorded as enrichment / acceptance
detail for the existing phases.

### Motore Knowledge Graph (KGCORE) -> enriches Phases 1-2-4 (GRAPH-*, SCHEMA-*)
source: documentazione/15-ambiti-estensione/20-motore-knowledge-graph-it.md

- [ ] **KGCORE-01**: Core domain-agnostic node types (DOCUMENT, PERSON, ORGANIZATION, PLACE, CONCEPT, EVENT, TECHNOLOGY) + core relations (RELATED_TO, PART_OF, LOCATED_IN, WORKS_AT, CREATED_BY, DEPENDS_ON, REFERENCES, MENTIONED_IN) — enriches GRAPH-01
- [ ] **KGCORE-02**: Weighted edges in [0,1] with configurable per-domain WeightPolicy — enriches GRAPH-08

## Summary

- Per-vertical requirement groups created: **25** (10 consumer + 9 enterprise application
  verticals = 19 granular v1 phase candidates; 6 cross-cutting domains that enrich existing
  phases 1-7).
- Total requirement entries extracted: **~195** across the 25 groups.
- Existing v1 requirement families (GRAPH/SCHEMA/SEARCH/VIZ/RAG/INGEST/PRIV/CONS/ENT/DOCS in
  `.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md`) remain the spine; the cross-cutting groups map onto them and
  the 19 application verticals replace the v2 umbrella items AMBIT-01 / AMBIT-02.

### Operational baseline parameters relevant to existing KG requirements
- Qdrant document-chunk collection: localmind_documents (gRPC 6334 / HTTP 6333) — KG nodes MUST use separate collection localmind_graph_nodes. Relevant to SEARCH-02/INGEST-01/INGEST-02. Source: 02-document-intelligence-rag.md
- Document upload endpoint: POST /api/v1/documents/upload — INGEST-01 must extend, not replace. Source: 02-document-intelligence-rag.md
- Document status lifecycle: PENDING -> PROCESSING -> INDEXED/FAILED -> ARCHIVED — INGEST-01 must respect. Source: 02-document-intelligence-rag.md
- Agent endpoint: POST /api/v1/agents/execute {agentType, query} — must coexist with new GraphRAG endpoint. Source: 03-ai-agents.md
- n8n event types: NEW_FILE, DOCUMENT_INDEXED, DOCUMENT_FAILED, SCHEDULED, CHAT_COMPLETED, AGENT_EXECUTED — enterprise vertical may need GRAPH_NODE_CREATED/GRAPH_RELATION_ADDED. Source: 04-automazioni-n8n.md
- Dashboard health polling: GET /api/v1/dashboard/health every 30s. Relevant to Phase 6/7 frontend. Source: 06-dashboard-monitoraggio.md
